title: Teapot with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="62" r="3" fill="#F48FB1" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="62" r="3" fill="#F48FB1" opacity="0.85"/>
</svg>
